# Upstream workflows omitted

This repository was imported as a clean snapshot from commit
`b5a865a8a4069922f4cf60b8a1f4e1138e8062e7` of
`euclidprojects/Euclid-Linux-3D-Budgie-Wayfire`.

The source `.github/workflows` directory was intentionally omitted because
GitHub's automatic Actions token is not permitted to create or update workflow
files. The omitted files are upstream Nixpkgs CI automation and are not needed
to preserve or develop the Euclid Linux source tree.
